title: Probe: flush phase uses grandchild-hang and the comment is corrected (WCLI-21 #341 r4 nit 2)
description: In test/fixtures/tpm2-command-exit-probe.ts the flush phase installs tpm2_flushcontext as plain 'hang', so no pipe-holding grandchild sits on the flush path as the unseal phase does, and the comment 'the probe's own exit is the proof that it asked to exit' overstates: the probe exits through the process-group kill and the printed explicit=true is the proof. Use grandchild-hang for the flush phase and correct the comment.
